reports.title: Audit of Micro-Starknet
reports.description: Kudelski Security code audit, for StarkWare, of the Micro-Starknet TypeScript library (Stark curve keys and signatures, Pedersen and Poseidon hashing) at commit 07b25e9, with focus on hashing, randomness and constant-time behaviour. The library is an offchain JavaScript cryptographic dependency (used by starknet.js), not onchain protocol logic.

reports.title: NM-0194 Starknet Token Distributor Security Review
reports.description: Nethermind security review (NM-0194) for the Starknet Foundation of the Cairo Merkle-tree Distributor contract in the defispring repository, which lets users claim STRK against owner-published Merkle roots. Six Info and Best Practices findings were reported, with fixes reviewed up to commit be3ca1f.

versions.coverage: Full review of the distributor contract at the initial commit.
Fix commit for finding 7.5 (Best Practices, unchecked token transfer return value); review limited to that fix.
Fix commit for finding 7.4 (Best Practices, import grouping); review limited to that fix.
Fix commit for findings 7.3 (Info, leaf/node hash collision) and 7.6 (Best Practices, Poseidon hashing); Nethermind noted leaves were still hashed with Pedersen and test data was not updated.
Final commit of the review: follow-up fix for findings 7.3 and 7.6 (Poseidon-hashed leaves, Pedersen tree nodes); review limited to the fixes.
Full review of the file (module declarations) at the initial commit.

reports.title: Audit of Herodotus' Integrity - A Cairo Verifier compatible with Starknet written in Cairo 1
reports.description: Four-week zkSecurity audit for Herodotus of Integrity, a Cairo 1 STARK/FRI verifier for Cairo programs deployed on Starknet, checking soundness and divergences from StarkWare's Cairo 0 verifier (cairo-lang v0.13.2, used only as reference) including split contracts, split proofs, Cairo 1 programs and Stone v6 proofs. One High (lack of specification), three Medium and one Low findings were reported without a fix review.

versions.coverage: All *.cairo files under src, focused on STARK/FRI soundness and divergences from the cairo-lang Cairo 0 verifier. Finding 00 (High, lack of specification) is located project-wide; the Medium findings concern air/public_input, air/layouts/recursive/public_input.cairo and air/layouts, the Low one fri. Severities are given in the zkSecurity web version of the report.

reports.title: StarkWare Cryptography Audit OS
reports.description: ABDK review for StarkWare of the update to the Cairo library and the Starknet OS between cairo-lang v0.10.1 and v0.12.1, covering keccak, Poseidon, secp, Patricia and hash-state library code plus OS contract-class hashing, transaction and syscall execution, state and output. No Critical or Major issues were found; 19 Moderate and 16 Minor recommendations were reported.

reports.title: Starknet Staking Cairo Application Security Audit
reports.description: Zellic assessment for StarkWare of the Starknet Staking v1 contracts (staking, pool, reward supplier, minting curve, shared roles/replaceability components and the L1 MintManager/RewardSupplier Solidity contracts) in two review periods, at 1fb6d43 (September 2024) and e4f75ea (November 2024). It reported one Critical, three High, four Medium, four Low and three Informational findings (by impact rating), most fixed in listed commits.

versions.coverage: All *.cairo files under the staking contracts package (report glob apps/staking/contracts/**/*.cairo). Findings 3.2 (High, tx-initiator authentication) in the Staking contract and 3.3 (High) in reward_supplier.cairo; 3.4, 3.5 and 3.6 (Medium impact; 3.6 carries a High severity label with Low likelihood, acknowledged only) in staking.cairo. Ratings follow Zellic's impact rating.
Fix commit for finding 3.3 (on_receive sender check in reward_supplier.cairo); review limited to that fix.
Fix commit for finding 3.4 (Medium, operational address overwrite in staking.cairo); review limited to that fix.
Fix commit for finding 3.2 (removes the Operator contract and tx-initiator authentication in staking.cairo); review limited to that fix.
Fix commit for finding 3.7 (Low, governance admin self-revocation), which also touches the staking, pool, reward supplier and minting curve contracts; review limited to that fix.

All *.cairo files under apps/staking/contracts/src. Finding 4.1 (High, incorrect reward transfers when switching to an exiting pool) in staking.cairo; 4.2 (Medium) and several Low/Informational findings in staking.cairo, pool.cairo and minting_curve.cairo.
Fix commit for finding 4.3 (Low, switching delegation to the same pool); review limited to that fix.
Fix commit for finding 4.5 (Informational, exit window limit); review limited to that fix.
Fix commit for findings 4.1 (High) and 4.4 (Low, stale total supply in minting_curve.cairo); review limited to those fixes.
All *.cairo files under the shared contracts package (report glob packages/contracts/**/*.cairo); finding 3.7 (Low) in components/roles/roles.cairo.
